unlocks.build.text.en: Raise houses, farms and workshops on the land you have cleared. Every building works for the kingdom, and grows with every level.

unlocks.research.text.en: The royal library is open. Spend Knowledge on technologies to unlock new buildings and make the kingdom thrive.

unlocks.heroes.text.en: Heroes lead your troops into battle. Call them at the Tavern, level them up and send them against the lairs around your kingdom.

unlocks.bookSagas.text.en: A book found at the Tavern. Its technologies are about heroes, and the Tavern that hosts them.

unlocks.relics.text.en: Relics of the old kingdom lie broken across the land. Find their six pieces in lairs and the fog, restore them, and they work for you again.

unlocks.bag.text.en: Chests, speed-ups and boosts you find are kept here until you use them. Open a chest when you need what is inside, or spend a speed-up on any timer.

unlocks.world.text.en: Beyond the mountains lie other kingdoms. From the Watchtower you can see the roads that lead to them.

unlocks.bookAtlas.text.en: A book found at the Watchtower. Its technologies sharpen sight, claim landmarks and reach for the world beyond.
